tools.name: list_dress_codes
tools.description: The dress-code ladder from least to most formal (casual → white tie), with a one-line meaning for each and general tips for vague invitations. Use to compare codes or orient before explaining one.

tools.name: explain_dress_code
tools.description: Explain what a dress code on an invitation means (e.g. smart casual, business casual, cocktail, semi-formal, lounge suits, black tie optional, black tie, white tie): a dress/skirt route, a trouser/suit route, what to avoid, and the neighbouring codes.

tools.name: suggest_outfit
tools.description: Build a written outfit formula from clothes people usually already own, for an occasion, the weather and a style mood. Returns five pieces with notes, a three-colour palette, why it works, and a link to adjust it in the Delve to Life outfit studio.

tools.name: colour_combinations
tools.description: Twelve tested clothing colour combinations with how to wear them, plus four colour-wheel shortcuts. Optionally filter by a colour the user already owns (e.g. "olive", "navy", "brown").

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Find the most relevant Delve to Life style guide for a question (dress codes, weddings, funerals, interviews, weather, colour, proportion, screen-inspired style). Returns titles, URLs, summaries and quick answers.
